title: SpikeSSL: A Universal Spike Inference Framework with Dynamics-Informed State-Space Layers
abstract: arXiv:2610.11456v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Two-photon calcium imaging is a standard tool for recording large neural populations in vivo, yet inferring spikes accurately across the growing diversity of calcium indicators remains an open problem. Existing supervised methods achieve reasonable in-domain accuracy but generalize poorly to unseen indicators, because different indicators induce distinct fluorescence kinetics and signal statistics while existing architectures remain relatively simple generic temporal regressors without dynamics-matched inductive bias. We propose SpikeSSL, a universal spike inference framework whose temporal backbone is a bank of bidirectional IIR state-space layers broadly motivated by calcium dynamics. translated_title: SpikeSSL：一种基于动力学信息的通用尖峰推断框架与状态空间层
translated_abstract: 双光子钙成像是在体记录大规模神经群体活动的标准工具，然而在日益多样化的钙指示剂中准确推断尖峰仍是一个悬而未决的问题。现有的监督方法在域内能取得合理的精度，但对未见过的指示剂泛化能力较差，这是因为不同的指示剂会产生不同的荧光动力学和信号统计特性，而现有架构仍然只是相对简单的通用时间回归器，缺乏与动力学相匹配的归纳偏置。我们提出了 SpikeSSL，这是一个通用的尖峰推断框架，其时间主干是一组受钙动力学启发的双向 IIR 状态空间层。一个多模态条件编码器将指示剂身份、采样率和信号踪迹级统计特性映射为一个全局条件向量，通过自适应层归一化对主干进行调制，同时一个异方差方差头提供经校准的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: SpikeSSL 提出了一种以受钙动力学启发的双向 IIR 状态空间层为时间主干、并通过多模态条件编码器融合指示剂身份、采样率与信号统计信息的通用尖峰推断框架，能够跨多种钙指示剂实现准确且具有校准不确定度的尖峰推断。
en_tdlr: SpikeSSL is a universal spike inference framework whose temporal backbone consists of calcium-dynamics-informed bidirectional IIR state-space layers, modulated by a multi-modal conditioning encoder capturing indicator identity, sampling rate, and signal statistics, enabling accurate generalization across diverse calcium indicators with calibrated uncertainty.
